authority: Explicit human interpretation supplied by parent in trusted transcript evidence; not an assertion of new official GW text.
literal: `Objective range is 3″ horizontally and 5″ vertically. For a model measured using its body, could one part meet the horizontal limit and a different part meet the vertical limit, even though neither meets both?` - since we are using event companion all the objectives in our games/training will be Terrain Objectives. For completeness though, use same physical point to satisfy both limits.
adopted_predicate: exists one physical point p with H(p,marker)<=3 AND V(p,marker)<=5
not_adopted: Independent axis witnesses, or selecting only the Euclidean-nearest point.
primary_scenario_policy: Terrain Objectives are primary for Event Companion games/training. This change concerns fallback marker completeness; terrain occupancy remains unchanged.
scope_qualification: Declared compound FRAME typed geometry is supported; native catalog/body admission, legal setup and prior history remain unproved.
